plugins.name: aeo-content
plugins.description: GreenM AEO content authoring — 8-stage workflow with Stage 2.5 workspace provisioning (drafts folder + Linear ticket pair assigned to initiator), channel- and voice-aware output, Track-1/Track-2 image split with mandatory concept rationale and Featured/OG legibility gates. Pairs with greenm-webflow-publish to cover the full pipeline from topic to live post.
plugins.author: Sierikov <osierikov@greenm.io>

plugins.name: greenm-webflow-publish
plugins.description: End-to-end Webflow publishing for GreenM — blog posts and case studies. Krea image generation, Data API asset upload, staging→prod, validation, Rich Text embed handling for tables and body images.
plugins.author: Sierikov <osierikov@greenm.io>
